candidates.entry: long GLD when 30d return > 0 AND 60d SMA of GLD is rising
candidates.exit: close position when 30d return <= 0 OR after 90 days
candidates.sizing: allocate 2% of portfolio equity to each GLD trade (fixed fractional)
candidates.regime_filter: skip when 30d rolling volatility of GLD > 2.0%
candidates.rationale: Time-series momentum has been shown to generate >0.5 Sharpe in commodity futures; applying the same rule to the gold ETF yields frequent signals and should meet Tier-2 thresholds.

candidates.entry: at month start compute 60d total return for each ETF in ['GLD','SLV','PPLT','PALL','CPER','DBA']; go long top 2 and short bottom 2
candidates.exit: rebalance monthly, closing all positions at month end
candidates.sizing: equal risk weight to each leg targeting 10% annualized portfolio volatility
candidates.regime_filter: skip month when 30d rolling volatility of SPY > 1.5%
candidates.rationale: Cross-sectional momentum is robust across commodities; monthly rebalancing across six ETFs creates many trades while preserving a strong risk-adjusted return.

candidates.entry: long GLD when price < 0.95 * 200d SMA AND short GLD when price > 1.05 * 200d SMA; same rule for SLV
candidates.exit: close when price crosses its 200d SMA
candidates.sizing: fixed 1% of portfolio equity per leg (long or short)
candidates.regime_filter: skip when 30d rolling volatility of GLD or SLV > 2.5%
candidates.rationale: The value strategy (price relative to long-term average) generated ~0.6% monthly alpha in futures; applying it to gold and silver ETFs should capture similar mispricing while keeping turnover high enough for >100 trades.

candidates.entry: long CPER when 30d return > 0 AND CPER price > 12-month SMA (proxy for backwardation)
candidates.exit: close when 30d return <= 0 OR CPER price falls below 12-month SMA
candidates.sizing: scale to target 8% annualized portfolio volatility
candidates.regime_filter: skip when VIX (proxied by 30d SPY volatility) > 25
candidates.rationale: Combining momentum with a simple carry proxy mirrors the joint carry-momentum effect documented for commodities and should generate a strong Sharpe on the energy ETF.

candidates.entry: long DBA when 60d return > 0 AND DBA price < 0.97 * 200d SMA
candidates.exit: close when 60d return <= 0 OR price crosses above 200d SMA
candidates.sizing: fixed 2% of portfolio equity per trade
candidates.regime_filter: skip when 30d rolling volatility of DBA > 2.0% OR when 30d SPY volatility > 1.5%
candidates.rationale: Agricultural commodities exhibit both momentum and value signals; layering a value filter on top of momentum reduces drawdowns while preserving trade frequency.
